title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out 14 batters in six innings, allowing two hits, as the Red Sox defeated the Athletics 13-1.
Boston's offense produced 15 hits and multiple high-scoring innings, extending their streak to nine consecutive wins.
Reliever Raymond Burgos debuted, pitching three hitless innings as the Red Sox improved their record to 64-51.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez engage in competitive battles at Patriots training camp, enhancing each other's skills.
Christian Gonzalez uses intentional trash talk to prepare A.J. Brown for facing top NFL corners this season.
Gonzalez's training against Brown aims to ready him for a challenging 2026 receiver schedule, amid contract negotiations.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman, acquired by the Red Sox, will start a rehab assignment Saturday with Triple-A Worcester.
Rutschman was placed on the injured list July 20 for left wrist inflammation, missing games since July 18.
Boston traded three prospects and Carlos Narvaez to Baltimore for Rutschman, who is a three-time All-Star.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' debuts on Paramount+ as a sequel to the popular Nickelodeon series.
'The Ballad of Wallis Island' streams on Peacock, featuring Tim Key as a lottery winner reuniting a folk duo.
'Ted Lasso' Season 4, with Jason Sudeikis, premieres on Apple TV, focusing on a women's football team.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet, sidelined since April with injuries, may return to the Red Sox bullpen in 2026.
Interim manager Chad Tracy suggests Crochet is unlikely to return as a starter before the season ends.
Crochet is open to a bullpen role, aiming to contribute to Boston's successful 2026 season.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python named 'Tippy' was found near Ellington Street in Dorchester and is now at an animal care facility.
Boston Animal Care and Control was alerted after the snake was left in a cage at a community food garden.
Officials ask anyone with information about the python to contact Boston Animal Care and Control at 617-635-1800.

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Tommy DeVito led Team Blue to a 22-15 victory over Drake Maye's Team White in a Patriots scrimmage.
DeMario Douglas starred for Team Blue with six catches and two touchdowns, including a 50-yard reception.
Will Campbell and Carlton Davis are among the Patriots players dealing with injuries as training camp continues.

title: A closer look at Harwich, voted the best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich, known for its 11 miles of shoreline, was voted the best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers.
Harwich offers a variety of attractions, including beaches, conservation areas, and cultural sites appealing to all ages.
Popular spots in Harwich include Saquatucket Harbor, The Port Restaurant & Bar, and the Cape Cod Lavender Farm.

title: DA’s office says prosecutor’s ‘hot mic’ moment in Lindsay Clancy trial was misheard
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: The Plymouth DA's office clarified a 'hot mic' incident, stating someone said 'shut it off' about autopsy photos.
Defense attorney Kevin Reddington accused prosecutors of saying 'shut her up' during Lindsay Clancy's emotional courtroom moment.
Judge William Sullivan warned against inappropriate comments, emphasizing immediate removal for violations in court.

title: Little boy dancing to DJ on Boston Common has hundreds of thousands of new fans
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: 4-year-old Chukwuemeka Ikesinachi-Nwogwugwu's dance on Boston Common DJ show garners over 200,000 likes on social media.
Chidimma Ikesinachi was surprised by the online reaction and praises for her son's spontaneous dance performance.
Local DJ Miss S. Peace aimed to promote human connection during her show, attended by supportive friend Kelly Werme.
